newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Sivensa mulls extra dividend.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Sivensa mulls extra dividend.

text.p: Venezuelan steel company Sivensa is considering a one-for-one stock dividend in addition to its traditional quarterly cash dividend of 0.20 bolivars per share (US$0.04), the company said.
At the annual board meeting on Friday, the company said it also decided to recommend an extraordinary cash dividend of 2.50 bolivars per share.
Both proposals will be considered at the next general shareholders' meeting on January 31, 1997, the company said in a press release.
Inflation-adjusted third quarter net profits rose to 5.3 billion bolivars at the end of June, versus 3.7 billion the year before.
That 44 percent rise took nine-month net profits to 20.4 billion bolivars versus 7.4 billion in the year before.
The fiscal year runs from October to September.
